canonical_claim.template: Ginnie Mae Monthly Issuance Report (Issuance Summary) (May 2026 report) reports Ginnie Mae II total, month of May 2026: {value} USD millions, May 2026.

required_qualifiers.source: Ginnie Mae Monthly Issuance Report (Issuance Summary), May 2026 report, Table 1: Monthly Issuance Summary (In Millions)
required_qualifiers.exclusions: Mortgage-backed securities issued under Ginnie Mae I and Ginnie Mae II programs, in USD millions; a securities-issuance figure, not a count of loans
required_qualifiers.nature: official figure restated as printed; not computed or adjusted by FinanceRateCalc

does_not_establish: a number of loans, originations or applications (it is a dollar amount of securities issued)
FHA-only activity (Ginnie Mae pools also hold VA, USDA and PIH loans)
that the figure has not been revised in a later edition (check the latest report)
rule: Free text is the OUTPUT of evidence, not its input. Certify before you write.

proposed_use.proposed_sentence: This lender will likely reject YOUR application
